claims.text: The FDA capecitabine label reports altered coagulation or bleeding, including death, with oral vitamin K antagonists, the class containing acenocoumarol.
claims.quote: Altered coagulation parameters and/or bleeding, including death, have been reported in patients taking capecitabine concomitantly with oral vitamin K antagonists.

claims.text: A case report describes rectal bleeding and increased INR in an 80-year-old woman taking acenocoumarol and capecitabine.
claims.quote: We describe an 80-year-old woman who presented with rectal bleeding and an increased INR due to the concomitant use of acenocoumarol and capecitabine for atrial fibrillation and metastatic cecal cancer, respectively.

headline.text: The FDA capecitabine label reports potentially fatal bleeding with vitamin K antagonists, including the class containing acenocoumarol.

reported.text: The boxed warning reports altered coagulation and bleeding with oral vitamin K antagonists.
A case report specifically describes rectal bleeding and elevated INR with acenocoumarol plus capecitabine.
